name: Ward's Berry Farm
tagline: Home – Wards Berry Farm, Sharon MA
description: Ward's Berry Farm is a pumpkin patch in 614 South Main Street, MA. Visitors come for Pumpkins, Corn, Tomatoes, Flowers, and Sunflowers, best in autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Sep – Nov in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
